t: Beyond the Algorithm: Reclaiming the Narrative
s: Control over hardware startup states and default software experiences, particularly browsers and operating systems, dictates public discourse and media consumption. Companies like Google leverage platform and browser dominance to shape narratives and drive revenue, while emerging 'super-apps' and platforms like X challenge this hegemony.
sub: Hardware startup states as narrative control points
Browser dominance and search overflow for narrative shaping
The rise of 'super-apps' and their impact on user experience
X (formerly Twitter) as an alternative influencer feed
